popCulture.title: Theogony
popCulture.creator: Hesiod
popCulture.description: Hesiod's Cronus swallows Hestia, Demeter, Hera, Hades, and Poseidon — until the stone and Zeus force the disgorging.

popCulture.title: Cronus
popCulture.description: The Titan who ate his children remains Western myth's image of time devouring its own succession.

popCulture.title: Rhea (mythology)
popCulture.description: The mother who saved Zeus with a swaddled stone — the hinge between swallowed siblings and Olympian rule.
